plugins/pdstack/skills/setup-pdstack/scr.why: Node port of check-sheet.sh and check-sheet.awk, because pdstack scripts are Node only (spec sections 9 and 13). Same CLI, default sheet, output, and exit codes. Also checks family lines and `<family>:<model>` values through sheet.mjs (spec section 10).
Node port, because pdstack scripts are Node only (spec sections 9 and 13). Same CLI, output, and exit codes. The decoder lives in sheet.mjs.

Node port, because pdstack scripts are Node only (spec sections 9 and 13). Also holds the decoder of read-sheet.sh. Reads the roles from models.json at run time in place of the stamped list. Drops the shell reader hooks (`sheet_read`, `sheet_quote`), because v1 has no hook. Accepts `family <name>: <command>` lines and `<family>:<model>` role values (spec section 10): a family entry needs a family line, a family line needs a valid name and `{model}` in its command, and a family counts as one vendor in a panel.

plugins/pdstack/skills/setup-pdstack/SKI.why: Spec sections 9 and 10. Removes step 4 (the session hook) and the `session hook` line and its mentions in the sheet header, step 7, step 8, and Other runtimes. Step 4 now adds model families: CLI detection on PATH, `family <name>: <command>` lines, `<family>:<model>` role values, one test call for each model through `scripts/run-external.mjs`, the offer to put a new family in the cross-family roles, and the Claude-only gap statement in step 8. Step 6 runs the Node `check-sheet.mjs` after the write. New step 11 detects stack packs, asks for the worktree home, writes `.agents/pdstack.json` with only the keys that differ from the defaults, and validates it with `check-config.mjs`. New step 12 makes `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` and `docs/agents/domain.md` when absent, which replaces setup-matt-pocock-skills. The description names the new jobs.
